method.noise: 25,000/s for70s,64ports atoneIPv4,4096-packet bursts,captured transport prefix with altered ciphertext
method.useful: Reverse UDP6000 application datagrams/s,128-byte payload,60s requested; same separate iperf3 3.18 startup-reorder benchmark as v22-v24
method.WAN: RTT300ms,jitter30ms per A-B direction,half RTT delay each direction including mTLS; netem queue16384,no configured random loss;20preflight physical pings
method.movement: Only disposable client-gateway NAT changes;two or three moves100/250/1200ms apart after each conntrack deletion;unchanged native profiles,keys,ports and binaries
method.gateway: Same corrected INPUT model as v24,identical for every variant; only unmatched local reverse UDP drops before conntrack confirmation. No production or Windows firewall changes. Isolated negative control was v24,not repeated here.
method.delivery: Complete inner captures,unique UDP sequences including GSO/GRO; iperf-reported loss separate; capture does not prove application consumption
method.probes: 100ordinary perprofile at500ms plus100frequent at50ms; deadline1s unchanged; timely,late,captured separate
method.attempts: Journal selection logs,not delivery receipts;current key/endpoint checked before each batch; packets submitted to a vanished path cannot be recalled
method.builds: Cached offline build and tests in1core/1GiB entry guest; no compiler overlaps workload; immutable source snapshots per variant; no CPU quota

limits: Only one moving native profile and one stationary probe profile; physical GUI clients and simultaneous WAN movement of several peers untested.
This stage measures6000/s with128-byte payload,not higher PPS or large-packet throughput. The fixed client replay window and2MiB budgets still limit recovery.
All snapshots expire at their original1100ms deadline; further moves can outlast it. No qualifying fresh packet means no replay.
Global byte/send limits are unchanged,but one peer can now use the entire global attempt allowance; return reachability,peer fairness and state exhaustion need separate testing.
DPI,unlinkability,distributed source noise and physical router behavior are untested. Snapshot recovery remains experimental and off by default.
